subject.title: feat(bedrock): enable prompt caching for Nova models

question: Should Nova prompt caching use the existing provider cache-eligibility hook, or should OpenClaw intentionally add `compat.supportsCacheRetention` as a second permanent provider contract?
rationale: The PR adds a generic provider-facing runtime capability despite an existing hook for the same eligibility decision; choosing the permanent contract affects plugin API coherence and future provider implementations.

options.title: Reuse the existing hook
options.body: Remove the parallel runtime compat flag, declare Nova eligibility through the current provider hook, and require live AWS proof before merge.

options.title: Approve the new capability
options.body: Keep `supportsCacheRetention` only with explicit approval, contract documentation, and compatibility tests explaining how it differs from the existing hook.

options.title: Pause Nova enablement
options.body: Leave the canonical feature issue open until an owner confirms the API direction and a Nova-enabled account can provide live evidence.

recommendation.title: Reuse the existing hook
recommendation.body: Remove the parallel runtime compat flag, declare Nova eligibility through the current provider hook, and require live AWS proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is the merged shared and Bedrock cache-retention work defining the affected contract boundary.
